description: This Java source file defines the NetworkChangeNotifierAutoDetect class, which listens to platform connectivity changes on Android devices. It manages network state detection, callbacks, and observer notifications, supporting various Android API levels and handling VPNs, WiFi, and mobile networks.

classes.name: NetworkChangeNotifierAutoDetect
classes.description: Main class that detects network changes on Android, manages callbacks, and notifies observers.

classes.name: NetworkState
classes.description: Immutable class representing the current state of a network connection.

classes.name: ConnectivityManagerDelegate
classes.description: Helper class to interact with Android's ConnectivityManager for network info.

classes.name: WifiManagerDelegate
classes.description: Helper class to retrieve WiFi SSID information.

classes.name: DefaultNetworkCallback
classes.description: Callback for network events on pre-Android R devices.

classes.name: AndroidRDefaultNetworkCallback
classes.description: Callback for network events on Android R and above, handling capabilities and link properties.

classes.name: MyNetworkCallback
classes.description: Handles network events such as availability, loss, and changes, including VPN handling.

classes.name: RegistrationPolicy
classes.description: Abstract class defining when to start and stop listening for network changes.

classes.name: NetworkConnectivityIntentFilter
classes.description: Intent filter for connectivity change broadcasts.

methods.name: getCurrentNetworkState
methods.description: Returns the current network state by querying the delegate.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers the network change listener, callbacks, and broadcast receiver.

methods.name: connectionTypeChanged
methods.description: Triggers observer notification if network state has changed.

methods.name: connectionTypeChangedTo
methods.description: Updates observer with specific network state changes.

methods.description: Filters and returns networks that are useful and accessible.
